extra_citations.why: Thm 1: weight decay on a two-layer ReLU network is equivalent to l1 regularisation of the top layer with unit-norm hidden units, proved by AM-GM plus positive-homogeneous rescaling. This is the canonical ML precedent for the per-neuron AM-GM price, in the nonlinear homogeneous setting (b=nu=2, s=1).
Earliest source (credited by Kolb et al. 2025) that a quadratic penalty on multiplicative factors equals the lasso penalty. Bib fields confirmed via Crossref DOI metadata.
